name: Voxel Deformation with Spherical Falloff
definition: Modifies the density field within a spherical region defined by a world position and radius, using a soft falloff to create smooth edges for digging or building operations.
summary: Voxel Deformation with Spherical Falloff modifies terrain mass using a continuous soft falloff function for smooth edges, supporting both additive and subtractive operations unlike binary carving.
